create.name: Yoga Mukti
create.bio:
Yoga Mukti is an Iyengar yoga school in Santiago de Chile, started in 2000 by Rishi Joseph, a student certified by B.K.S. Iyengar who still directs it. The name comes from the Sanskrit for liberation, and the school sees itself as a link between the Indian tradition and the growing number of practitioners in Chile. Over its first quarter-century it has hosted senior visiting teachers from the wider Iyengar community, including Faeq Biria and H.S. Arun, and it has become a training ground for many of the country's certified teachers.

Classes run at two Santiago houses, the original one near Plaza Ñuñoa and a second in Las Condes, with a team of six teachers covering introductory, general, intermediate and seniors' classes, regular pranayama sessions and a Sunday practice for teachers. Most levels can also be followed live on Zoom. Students who want to teach are prepared through the method's mentorship route, assisting a certified teacher over several years, and the school holds retreats outside the city. Its YouTube channel shares full-length classes, a beginners' course and talks on the life of B.K.S. Iyengar.

courses.title: Planes y Valores (monthly plans, Ñuñoa, Las Condes and online)
courses.description: Monthly plans for two, three or daily classes at either Santiago house, or for live Zoom classes, plus single drop-in classes. A one-off enrolment fee applies to in-person plans.
courses.price: Ñuñoa: matrícula $30.000; mensualidad 2 veces por semana $56.000, 3 veces $65.000, 1 clase/día $70.000; clase suelta $12.000. Las Condes: matrícula $50.000; 2 clases por semana $72.000, 3 clases $82.000, libre asistencia $92.000; clase suelta $15.000. Online: 2 clases x semana $50.000 / USD 60; 3 clases $70.000 / USD 80; 4 clases $80.000 / USD 90

courses.title: Formación de profesores (Iyengar teacher mentorship)
courses.description: The school's route to teaching the Iyengar method: several years of steady practice with a certified teacher, followed by a mentorship in which the student assists in classes and learns to demonstrate and adjust. Enquiries go to the school's certified teacher trainer.

free_resources.title: Clases gratuitas en YouTube
free_resources.description: The school's channel of full-length recorded classes, a four-week introductory course, pranayama sessions and a series of talks on the life of B.K.S. Iyengar, linked from the site's menu as free classes.
